sources.title: Border Police FAQ

sources.officialityEvidence: The official Border Police FAQ is published on granpol.gov.ba and states the domestic classification for BiH citizens holding another citizenship.

policies.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina ordinary passport: citizenship/home entry
policies.summary: A traveller using an ordinary Bosnia and Herzegovina passport is a BiH citizen rather than a foreign visitor under the visa regime.
conditions: The Border Police says that a BiH citizen who holds another citizenship is not considered a foreigner in BiH.
This does not decide treatment for a dual national presenting another passport, work, residence, transit, document validity, security controls or final admission.

policies.title: Bahrain, Oman and Saudi Arabia ordinary passports: temporary visa-free entry through 30 September 2026
policies.summary: Official Gazette 37/26 exempts ordinary passport holders of Bahrain, Oman and Saudi Arabia from a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay from 1 June through 30 September 2026.
conditions: The waiver is limited to ordinary passport holders of Bahrain, Oman and Saudi Arabia.
The aggregate stay during the stated temporary period is no more than 60 days.
It does not establish entry after 30 September 2026, work, residence, special-passport, document, security or final-admission treatment.
